Episode 134. Duel on the Ship (4)
Zing, zing!
Jin's released energy made Mary feel as if thousands, tens of thousands of awls were piercing her skin.
'Just by gathering his energy, the mere presence of Jin creates such pressure...!'
Inside the spreading energy that looked like giant blue veins, Jin's eyes, dyed with life force, emitted various lights. As their eyes met, she involuntarily swallowed her dry saliva.
Her blood also boiled like crazy. Her life had always been filled with battles and wars, but there weren't many fights that made her heart feel this hot.
"Ugh!"
Although Cosmos was quite far away, he stumbled back, crushed by Jin's energy.
At least he was a considerable martial artist, so he only faltered, while other pirates nearby had already evacuated to the edge of the deck.
The hot and sharp energy even spread to the audience on Tikan's railing. Of course, the damage didn't reach the audience as their companions had put up a protective barrier beforehand.
The energy made the waves surge violently.
Particles of electric energy were carried by the sea breeze, flashing light in all directions, as if the star-filled night sky had been reduced and laid over the fleet.
If Jin decided to explode his energy, it would not only destroy the fleet and the pirates, but even the audience within the protective barrier could be caught in the disaster.
"Am, amazing! Jin! The Myeongwang Sword! The sword of the once strongest beings on the ground is now unfolding before your eyes!"
Despite that, Cosmos continued his excited commentary, and the audience had no intention of leaving their seats.
They didn't want to miss the biggest spectacle of their lives just because it was a bit dangerous.
Hoo!
Taking a deep breath, Mary was the first to move. The reason she had been still for a few seconds was not to wait for Jin, but to read the flow of his energy and find an opening to penetrate.
Although she couldn't properly understand the flow, which was different from aura, if she continued to wait, she would face a perfectly prepared technique.

'Has he reached a new level since the Sword Garden, or is this different from that sword? The energy is being released, but the fleet isn't damaged at all. There was no need to worry about disqualification.'
Mary thought that was the most mysterious phenomenon originating from Jin's energy.
The sea was surging, and such powerful energy reached the audience, but for some reason, not even a small scratch appeared on the deck.
Either way, Mary had no choice but to dive in with caution.
As soon as she stepped into the dense energy, she felt a tearing resistance throughout her body.
Mary also increased the aura of the Volcano to push away Jin's energy, but overall, Jin's energy was much stronger.
Her movements felt suffocating, as if she were underwater.
'Perhaps the only good thing is that Jin seems to be unable to move properly while maintaining this energy.'
Little by little, Mary approached, but Jin remained motionless in place like a statue.
He would end it in one breath.
It wasn't just Jin who made that judgment. Mary was also certain that a prolonged fight would put her at a disadvantage. That's why she started with a light-speed thrust.
As the distance between them shortened, the intensity of the electric energy increased.
It was hard to believe that just a while ago, she had seen Jin's colorful gaze from outside. Inside the storm of electricity, her vision was completely dark and hazy.
Now, there were about ten steps between them.
At this point, Mary didn't close the distance further. Instead, like Jin, she took a stance and began to concentrate.
"What's happening inside the storm of electricity?"
Whoosh!
The aura, blooming like smoke, pushed back the electric energy and formed a space. A hole was created in one side of the electric storm's hemisphere, allowing the audience to see Mary inside.
And the ensuing scene was a whirlwind.
A massive aura rotated around the blade of the Viper, forming a cross-shaped whirlwind. As the whirlwind rotated, Mary's space within the hemisphere of electricity expanded.
At that moment, Jin felt a chill throughout his body, as if a cold blade touched his neck.
'She intends to finish this in an instant.'
And fortunately,
Mary still mistakenly thought that the electric energy Jin had unleashed was a form of the Sword of the Myungwang Army or a technique of similar level.
'That's why she's trying to fight power with power.'
However, just as Mary didn't know that Jin's technique was merely a deception, Jin didn't know what sword she was about to unleash.
'At first, the stance is for a thrust.'
He could calculate that she intended to use the light-speed thrust again.
But that couldn't be all. It might be a light-speed thrust enhanced by the volcano, but there was no way she would end the fight with a technique that had already failed.
Sigmund's hilt was gripped tighter.
He widened his eyes to capture the moment the Viper moved. That's when the outcome would be decided.
'This is a sword prepared for you, little brother.'
Mary's shoulder twitched.
The scene seemed to unfold like a slow-motion video. Thanks to all the nerves poured into it, she barely managed not to miss that moment.
Runcandel Technique No. 5
Light-Speed Thrust
While the second light-speed thrust also left no direct damage to the Tikan, its power was incomparable to the first one.
The hemisphere of electric energy tore apart, scattering countless dark particles in all directions. The view became distorted, as if tens of thousands of glass panes shattered all at once.
Particles of electric energy poured down like a shower.
Even Jin's comrades couldn't quickly determine whether Jin had dodged the light-speed thrust or not amidst the chaos.
However, the light-speed thrust didn't end there.
Determined, and as this was the last battle with her beloved brother before leaving on a journey, Mary had resolved to pour everything she had into this attack.
Twice.
The volcanic light-speed thrust didn't stop after one strike.
Swoosh!
The belatedly echoing sound of a shockwave announced it. The fact that the light-speed thrust had been executed in succession.
'She unleashed the light-speed thrust three times...!?'
That was something Jin hadn't expected.
However, it wasn't an unavoidable move. No matter how amazing or fast the light-speed thrust was, it could only be executed within a range that wouldn't destroy the fleet and the Tikan.
Left, right. Because the light-speed thrust almost simultaneously eroded both directions, Jin's available space to move was extremely limited.
Center.
Even the center wasn't entirely safe. The two light-speed thrusts that crossed the empty space created relentless after-effects in the central area.
Amidst the particles of the electric storm and the literally flesh-scorching gusts, Jin barely managed to maintain his balance.
'The two light-speed thrusts are merely a means to trap me.'
Now Jin couldn't dodge. Because of the light-speed thrusts maneuvering through the left and right empty spaces, the siblings were virtually standing one-on-one on a single-plank bridge.
Light spread out.
The afterglow and lingering images left by the spreading light-speed thrust, along with the scattered radiance from the broken electric energy, densely filled the distance between the siblings.
And she was charging.
Like a predator that had cornered its prey, Mary was running along the only remaining path.
Unable to avoid, and forced to confront a single offense and defense. In a way, the central path where the two were standing was the real stage of this duel, created by Mary.
'Anyway, she's like fire.'
Very impressive.
Mary's volcano emitted an even more dazzling light than before. The light of the volcano grew larger, overpowering the other lights, and was getting closer to Jin.
Jin hadn't predicted that Mary would create such a situation. And when predictions fail, one would usually be at a disadvantage.
However, for Jin, this was precisely the scenario he wanted to create. An unavoidable one-on-one.

For that, he had pretended to be the Sword of the Myungwang Army, and had scattered electric energy even more delicately than during the declaration of the master, making it appear as if he could control it better.
The electric energy particles that had formed a hemisphere and were now shattered and shining were merely a means to distract her vision.
It was a complete decoy.
The moment Mary, dyed in the volcano's color, approached him.
Jin loosened his grip on the Sigmund. The pale blade, now devoid of power, dropped to the ground and exploded with electric energy before bouncing away.
'What!?'
At that moment, Mary couldn't help but hesitate. She had assumed that her brother would unleash a Myungwang Army sword or something equivalent.
'Did this kid drop his sword out of fear that I might kill him...?! He wasn't that weak-willed!'
Of course, she didn't want to kill her youngest sibling either. She wanted a sibling to always compete with or fight alongside.
'Yes, he once mentioned that. He said he hesitated with his sword at a crucial moment when fighting Dante Hairan at the tournament.'
Even if Jin hesitated, Mary didn't plan to do so. That was because this wasn't Runcandel.
Just before striking her brother with a venomous snake, Mary felt a deep disappointment.
Considering his demeanor during the declaration of the master, she couldn't accept his current indecisive actions.
The fourth light-speed thrust.
That was the sword she had chosen.
Originally, she had thought of another sword. She wanted to pay homage to her brother by using the unfinished Five.
'If this is how it is, you need a lesson too. As your sister, I'll wake you up again!'
The light-speed thrust crossing the center was bound to inflict damage on the Tikan.
'...But I'm not without my weak spots like you.'
Family love.

The two people Mary felt the strongest bond with were Diphus and Jin. Therefore, Mary intended to unfold the fourth light-speed thrust in a way that wouldn't cause irreversible damage to Jin's refuge under the pretext of teaching him a lesson. Instead, she planned to beat him to the brink of death after the fight ended.
Also, she intended to strike with her sword while keeping an eye on Jin's condition so that he wouldn't die from the light-speed thrust.
But it was only after hearing the following sound that Mary realized that this was her own arrogance.
Shriek!
The clear and chilling sound of a sharp blade escaping its sheath.
Mary had momentarily forgotten what kind of person her youngest brother was. She had also forgotten that his beloved sword was a pair.
It was because she loved her youngest sibling so much that her heart kept widening in this situation, but the world of competition was always cold.
'You deceived me...!'
Sword of the Spirit Technique 7: Shadow Stealth
The sword Jin had hidden while scattering meaningless electric energy all around was precisely that.
